title: Choosing a Job
text:
Many young people go to university to learn a job. Some students study engineering, and others study medicine or art. Before they choose, they often talk to teachers and family members about their interests.

Some students do an internship during their studies. An internship is a short job where they learn new skills. After an internship, many students know better which career they want.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do some students study at university?
According to paragraph two, what is an internship?
options: A short job where students learn new skills

questions.text: Why do many students talk to teachers and family before they choose a course?
options: They want to find out what they are interested in
They have no interests at all
They want to change their name

questions.text: What can you infer about students who do an internship?
options: They may feel more sure about their future career

vocabulary.definition: a short job that helps you learn new skills
the job or type of work you do for many years
things that you like to do or learn about

paragraph_translations: Birçok genç, bir meslek öğrenmek için üniversiteye gider. Bazı öğrenciler mühendislik okur, diğerleri ise tıp ya da sanat okur. Seçim yapmadan önce genellikle öğretmenleri ve ailesiyle ilgi alanları hakkında konuşurlar.
Bazı öğrenciler eğitimleri sırasında staj yapar. Staj, yeni beceriler öğrendikleri kısa bir iştir. Staj sonrasında birçok öğrenci hangi kariyeri istediğini daha iyi bilir.
